summary.answer: Builds small/large equipment lists, edge arrows and three quick-item views. List-active/grid events refresh arrows; current/mid/top item predicates hide NONE IDs, and model links retain id/cycle/type validation. It sets default focus, installs close, calls optional PostLoadFunc, then configures free-cursor/navigation and returns self.
